# Decision: alt text template generated by the PIM

**Decided 2026-09-18.** The PIM generates alt text for every product image with the template `<Modello> <genere> – <categoria> Alpinaria` in Italian (e.g. "Dolomiti AquaStop W donna – scarponi da trekking Alpinaria") and `<Model> <gender> – <category> Alpinaria` in English. Detail shots append the view ("suola", "outsole"). Manual alt text overrides the template when present. Backfill of the 1,200 images without alt scheduled for November.
